_comment: Exp 42 — COMPOSER (expert encodings S_k), pre-registered run. Models on bench/exp41_configs/41c_first_principles_run.json but uses the PANEL-APPROVED CONVERGENCE REDESIGN (2026-05-23). NEW GATE (vs exp41c): (1) gamma is REPORTED, NEVER a convergence trigger — the former gamma-threshold trigger on the critical-quiescence path is DELETED; gamma is telemetry-only everywhere (state gate AND the alt path) and cannot trigger or block convergence. gamma is reported on BOTH series each round: gamma_all (all-severity decay) and gamma_critical (critical-only decay, reads ~1.0 at a clean convergence). (2) CONVERGENCE = critical decay flattened AND review clean: REQUIRES (a) gamma_alt_consecutive_zero_crit (3) consecutive rounds with zero NEW genuine critical findings on the SETTLED/verifier-filtered series, AND (b) no unresolved/unverified critical candidates (A4 fail-safe), AND (c) not contested, AND (d) not churning. All-severity novelty being non-zero does NOT block convergence — non-critical footnotes must not hold a clean critical run open. (3) A4 VERIFIER FAIL-SAFE (correctness-critical): an UNVERIFIED critical-severity candidate (status UNCONFIRMED, severity>=0.7) must NOT silently count as 'zero new critical' — such a candidate is excluded from the settled series, so without the guard a critical the system gave up on would vanish from the count. While any critical-severity UNCONFIRMED candidate is pending, the zero-critical streak does NOT accrue and convergence is BLOCKED; the count is LOGGED for HIL (per-round 'unverified_critical' field), never dropped silently. OPEN/CONTESTED/REOPENED criticals remain in-play (counted by the settled series + the state gate) and are NOT what A4 targets. (4) DIRECTIVE REFRAME: cdsfl_core_formal.md now frames the objective as building/validating a robust working solution under DIMINISHING RETURNS — value-weighted, not count-weighted; converge when further effort yields only marginal value; with two guards (value governs WHERE to spend effort, not whether a real defect counts as critical; and continuation past a quiet stretch requires naming a specific plausible high-value mechanism, not merely 'there might be more'). Target: bench/cdsfl_registry/composer.py (expert encodings S_k). Expectation: on a mature module the panel finds few/zero genuine criticals and converges via the critical-quiescence count path within the round budget, while the A4 fail-safe holds (no unverified critical silenced). Report BOTH directions: false-convergence-prevented AND true-convergence-preserved.
_stall_gamma_note: Neutralised for Exp 42 (2026-05-23). The stall detector (_check_stall_convergence) sets terminate=True when gamma>=stall_gamma_terminate under a churn/static window, and the round loop (reference_runner_v2.py ~line 5676) promotes that to run termination — a SECOND gamma-triggered convergence path beyond the redesigned gate. Per design #1 (gamma must not trigger convergence ANYWHERE), both stall-gamma thresholds are set above the gamma ceiling (1.0) so the stall path can NEVER fire via gamma in this run. This is a CONFIG-level neutralisation; the underlying stall-detector code still contains the gamma-trigger and is flagged for human review (see report). In exp41c the stall path never fired (gamma peaked at 0.24 < 0.45), so this is a latent-path guard, not a behaviour change vs the observed exp41c run.
_test_cmd_note: Software-verifier regression gate (runs in a sandbox against each proposed fix, 120s cap). bench/cdsfl_registry/composer.py has NO dedicated regression suite in bench/tests/. The dynamic-management suite is used as the available green-baseline regression guard. PRE-LAUNCH TODO (flagged 2026-05-23): add a composer-specific regression test (import + compose() smoke over the four-layer ordering + coherence-budget pruning) and point test_cmd at it so the verifier scores fixes against composer behaviour directly, not only the broader suite.

_convergence_criteria.description: PANEL-APPROVED REDESIGN gate (hardened_gate_enabled=false; 2026-05-23). gamma is REPORTED, NEVER a trigger or blocker — telemetry-only everywhere; reported on both series (gamma_all, gamma_critical). Converged iff ALL of: (a) gamma_alt_consecutive_zero_crit (3) consecutive rounds with zero NEW genuine critical findings on the settled/verifier-filtered series (critical decay has flattened); AND (b) no unverified critical candidate pending (A4 fail-safe — a UNCONFIRMED severity>=0.7 candidate blocks and is logged for HIL); AND (c) not contested; AND (d) not churning. All-severity novelty is NOT required to be low: non-critical footnotes must not block a clean critical convergence. gamma does NOT appear in the convergence condition.
_convergence_criteria.pass_condition: 3 consecutive zero-NEW-genuine-critical rounds (settled/verifier-filtered) AND no unverified (UNCONFIRMED, sev>=0.7) critical pending AND not contested AND not churning. gamma reported only.
_convergence_criteria.fail_condition: Any model fails to produce parseable output in 2+ consecutive rounds.

_pre_registration: Frozen 2026-05-23 before the run (panel convergence redesign). Thresholds: gamma_alt_consecutive_zero_crit=3, consecutive_rounds_required=3, earliest_stop_round=3, gamma_telemetry_only_until=14 (>= max_rounds=12, so gamma never gates), hardened_gate_enabled=false. gamma is REPORTED-ONLY (both series) and is neither a trigger nor a blocker. Convergence rests on the critical-quiescence count (3 consecutive zero-NEW-genuine-critical rounds, settled/verifier-filtered) guarded by the A4 verifier fail-safe (no unverified critical may silently count as zero). No tuning after results. Success = clean convergence via the critical-quiescence count path on the composer module within the round budget, with the post-run HIL materiality review confirming no genuine critical was silenced (verifier/A4 false-negative check). Failure modes to report honestly: (a) does not converge (over-production / verifier-rejection lag / persistent unverified critical) -> diagnose under cy; (b) converges but HIL finds a silenced genuine critical -> verifier too aggressive OR A4 mapping wrong. CX2 is wired separately and is NOT added as a 6th panel model.
_plan_ref: Exp 42, panel-approved convergence redesign 2026-05-23. Implements: gamma report-only (both series); critical-quiescence convergence (critical decay flattened + review clean, all-severity footnotes non-blocking); A4 verifier fail-safe (unverified critical blocks + logged for HIL); diminishing-returns directive reframe. Target: composer.py (expert encodings S_k). Runner: reference_runner_v2.py (v2 active for Exp 40-54).
